note: Short friendly lines the overhead build screen shows. {n} = squares, {name} = building name, {floors} = floors. Browser toasts: line 397, 401, 785, 1565, 1734, 3804.
bad: Driveways go on the edge, next to a street.
blocked: That spot is water or flood zone. Try dry land.
locked: That part is already started or sold. Pick open land.
occupied: Something is already there. Only a parking lot can be built over.
note_signal_close: Too close to a city light, so you got a full-access driveway instead.
note_signal_median: A light needs a gap in the median, so you got a full-access driveway instead.
note_median_blocks: The median blocks left turns, so this driveway is right in, right out.
undo_blocked: You cannot undo past a phase start or a turn.
ready_made_soon: Ready-made pieces are coming in the next update.
